## Search strategy

The protected PubMed query is in [final-query.txt](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-fa9b74053cc569e3/ours-codex-noseed-20260929T001038Z/work/final-query.txt). It searches PTSD and post-traumatic stress symptom terms, including PTSS. The trajectory and trauma-event blocks were tested but left out because each would exclude known relevant studies.

Under the harness cutoff, the query retrieved **32,186 records**. It found all 9 development records and all 3 held-out validation records. Those figures are relative recall against a small, pilot-derived set—not an estimate of total sensitivity. The query includes the required Entrez entry-date bound through **2016-01-24**; it has no publication-date (`[dp]`) limit.

The audit and validation manifest are [audit.md](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-fa9b74053cc569e3/ours-codex-noseed-20260929T001038Z/work/audit.md) and [validation-manifest.json](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-fa9b74053cc569e3/ours-codex-noseed-20260929T001038Z/work/validation-manifest.json). Delivery passed. The audit records the stale trauma-event probe as a limitation and notes that human PRESS peer review is pending.
